thread:
Ashley: Following PM-801 postmortem — quick sync to lock SLO changes and owners. Need concrete remediation steps and timeline.
Maria: Pattern is consistent: weekday morning arrival spike ~10:00-11:15 PST causing queue depth >75% and p99 blowups.
Dan: Proposed SLO split: baseline traffic p99=300ms, peak window p99=450ms (30d window), and introduce control-plane throughput SLO p95>=1100rps.
Priya: Can we also add a tail-latency SLO for large-batch requests (batch_size>64) to detect regressions caused by batching?
Ashley: Yes. Add batch-tail SLO: for batch_size>64 p99<=600ms.
Leo: I'll own dashboards: add a "batch_size by p99" panel, add 1h and 7d rollups, and a heatmap for request arrival times. Will create alert diffs.
Maria: I'll own remediation runbook: autoscaler policy changes (scale faster on queue depth), implement a soft batch_size cap at the router, and schedule capacity reserve for 09:45-11:30 PST for two weeks. PRs targeted by 2024-06-11.
Dan: I'll build a scheduled canary that runs a 10m burst to 1250rps during the window and validate autoscaler behavior. If not scaling within 75s, fire a test alert (pager off).
Ashley: Short-term mitigation: enable a temporary per-tenant request-rate limiter at the gateway to flatten the burst. Priya, can you check risk to latency for small requests?
Priya: I'll run a microbenchmark tomorrow and post results. If <2% p50 impact, we can enable for 2 weeks.
ops-bot: RFC created: RFC-4602 (SLO changes + mitigation plan) linked to PM-801.
Maria: Action list:
 - Maria: remediation runbook + autoscaler PR + router cap (due 2024-06-11)
 - Leo: dashboard panels + alert rules (p99_1h, p99_7d, batch_tail_panel, arrival_heatmap) (due 2024-06-09)
 - Dan: canary + load test suite + results in RFC (due 2024-06-07)
 - Priya: gateway limiter bench + go/no-go (due 2024-06-06)
 - Ashley: internal SLA note for sales/legal (due 2024-06-14)
Priya: Suggest adding a 3x burn-rate alert for error budgets over 6h to catch rapid regressions.
Ashley: Good call. Add both a 24h and 6h burn-rate alert.
Dan: Proposal for throttle automation: if queue_depth > 85% AND p99 > 600ms for 3m, throttle oversized batches by 30%. I'll sketch a PoC.
Maria: I'll add test cases to the regression harness for batch-size regressions and p99 spikes.
Leo: I'll attach panel links to RFC-4602 and add alert runbook snippets.
ops-bot: Reminder set: SLO-followup-checkin on 2024-06-20 10:00 PST.
Ashley: Let's aim to close infra reservation and PRs before the checkin. We'll decide then whether to update the public SLA.
Dan: I'll post a summary of canary runs and whether autoscaler changes met the 75s criteria.
Maria: PRs opened, tagging reviewers.
Priya: Benchmarks queued, expected results EOD tomorrow.
Ashley: Thanks all. Keep RFC-4602 updated and mark items done as you go. :thumbsup:
